title: Twenty Slack Bridge
tagline: Slack app for the self-hosted Twenty CRM
description: Deterministic Slack bot (Socket Mode) for Twenty CRM: /crm search, Log to CRM shortcut, link unfurls, opportunity notifications and an App Home tab. Configure it with environment variables (see README).
postInstallMessage: Set the environment variables with `cloudron env set --app $CLOUDRON-APP-FQDN KEY=value ...` (see README), then register the Twenty webhook as $CLOUDRON-APP-ORIGIN/webhooks/twenty.
